title: Microsoft outage disrupts UK medical and police services
excerpt: GP surgeries, pharmacies, and police services across the UK have been impacted by a widespread Microsoft outage.
body_html:
A recent Microsoft outage has caused disruptions across various essential services in the United Kingdom. Among the affected sectors are local GP surgeries, pharmacies, and police services.

The government is currently evaluating the overall impact that the technical issue has had on its operations. However, intelligence services and major airports have reportedly remained unaffected by the incident.

Authorities and the company are continuing to monitor the situation as the extent of the disruption is assessed.
